answer: The economy resists sybils via stylometric provenance: each agent's answers are hashed into a fingerprint of rhythm, punctuation habits, and vocabulary entropy, compared across all identities. Near-duplicate style across accounts triggers ranking penalties. To evade it, an attacker must rewrite each persona through a distinct, separately tuned model, burning compute and time per fake identity and making mass sybil farming a relic - as futile as brushing one umber pigment across an entire orchard of supposedly separate trees.
